payload.title: Turn it off from the message: signed links, a page and one-click unsubscribe
payload.description:
**Milestone:** M2, operators finished

**Goal.** As a recipient, every message lets me stop this kind, mute this incident or stop everything, without signing in.

**Build.**
- HTTP API + Lambda `handlers/public.py` at the notification domain. Pages for people, machine routes separate, as Papyrus's rule in `docs/newsletter.md`.
- Token format and checks from Papyrus `src/papyrus_content/newsletter/tokens.py`, key from `/caducus/link-key`. No address in a link.
- GET shows a button and changes nothing, because mail scanners fetch links (the same reasoning as Prospectus `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, Newsletter mailing lists). POST acts. RFC 8058 `List-Unsubscribe` and `List-Unsubscribe-Post` on every message that is not a one-off to one person, accepted without an origin check.
- Pages use `noindex`, `no-store`, a strict CSP and no scripts. Non-colour marks on buttons. Page design gets Ryan's screenshot review.

**Acceptance.**
Behave features plus a test that GET changes no state; Ryan's screenshot approval recorded.

**Depends on:** kanbus-222bcf, kanbus-cfe4b9

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Turning off from a message
  Scenario: A mail scanner follows the link
    When the manage link is fetched with GET
    Then nothing changes

  Scenario: One click
    When a mail provider posts the one-click unsubscribe for a kind
    Then that person gets no more of that kind and the answer is 200

  Scenario: Muting one incident
    Given an open incident
    When an operator presses "Mute this incident"
    Then they get no clearing message for it and other incidents still reach them
```
